newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco jumps 4.85 pct on sales report.
newsitem.headline: Meralco jumps 4.85 pct on sales report.

text.p: Manila Electric Co A jumped by five pesos, or by 4.85 percent, to 108 pesos by midsession on prospects of robust earnings this year, brokers said.

"Meralco was the only neglected blue chip during the past quarter, so people were encouraged after it reported that its 10-month sales volume grew by 11 percent," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities.
Shares of Meralco B rose by six pesos to 198.
On Tuesday, the country's largest power distributor said its sales volume in 10 months to October rose to 14.772 billion kilowatt-hours, up 11.1 percent from the year-ago period.
